source_review_limit: Repository review snapshot, not a fresh runtime test or release qualification.
positioning: Do not rebuild billing for every product. Connect product events and customer terms to a reusable billing engine.

offers.software_price: free proposed commercial positioning; verify repository license and distribution terms
included: receipts and exports supported by selected version

exclusions: determination that a business outcome actually occurred
promised high availability or point-in-time recovery
safety: This document describes a proposal. It grants no execution, spending, deployment or credential authority. Do not treat a link or a proposed requirement as an installed command or available API.

requirements.title: One understandable billing agreement
requirements.scope: Versioned policy template: price, unit, currency, acceptance authority, effective time and correction rules. Plain-English preview alongside exact configuration.
requirements.acceptance: A prepared operator configures one fixed-price outcome without Rust or timestamp-format knowledge; invalid or incomplete terms are rejected before activation.
requirements.evidence_limit: Guided setup exists but the simplest path still requires about 31 answers in the reviewed source.
requirements.required_evidence: Policy preview; invalid-input cases; observed setup recording

requirements.title: One trusted event contract
requirements.scope: Document customer, outcome, event ID, event time, acceptance evidence and policy version. Publish schemas and examples for the qualified profile.
requirements.acceptance: A valid accepted outcome produces the expected obligation; an unsupported event is rejected with a stable error and repair guidance.
requirements.evidence_limit: Narrow outcome billing is demonstrated; broad chained-work behavior must be separately qualified.

requirements.title: A defensible billing receipt
requirements.scope: Expose the accepted evidence, calculation, policy version and correction history in machine-readable output and a readable explanation.
requirements.acceptance: A reviewer can trace an amount back to source evidence and agreement. Replayed input does not create a second obligation; corrections preserve history.
requirements.evidence_limit: Existing receipt and replay evidence is narrow. General exactly-once external delivery is not established.
requirements.required_evidence: Replay, correction and explanation acceptance cases

requirements.title: Install without a toolchain
requirements.scope: Native archives, checksums, supported-platform matrix and one consistent installation path. Reuse existing native-packages issue #5.
requirements.acceptance: A clean supported machine runs the version and synthetic walkthrough without compiling Rust; failure explains the supported alternative.
requirements.evidence_limit: The product owner’s local session owns native packages. Do not duplicate its work.

requirements.title: Five-minute first receipt
requirements.scope: Synthetic sample, safe defaults, relative-time helpers, configuration file and a clear transition from demo to real customer data.
requirements.acceptance: Target: after installation, a new operator reaches and explains one synthetic receipt within five minutes without assistance. Report observed time and failures.
requirements.evidence_limit: An acceptance target, not a measured onboarding promise.
requirements.required_evidence: Timed observation with unfamiliar users and no production data

requirements.title: Thirty-second agent orientation
requirements.scope: A single operator quickstart, task-oriented AGENTS.md routing, a thin CLAUDE.md compatibility pointer where needed, capability manifest and versioned input/output schemas.
requirements.acceptance: An unfamiliar agent identifies supported version, safe entry point, required inputs, irreversible steps and success criteria within 30 seconds. It declines unsupported capabilities.
requirements.evidence_limit: Contributor instructions exist; operator discovery is incomplete. Documentation alone does not enforce permissions.
requirements.required_evidence: Cold-start evaluation; schema validation; refusal cases

requirements.title: Reliable integration handoff
requirements.scope: Align Python/Node outbox helpers with qualified statement versions, saved acknowledgments, stable IDs, retry semantics and command-specific help.
requirements.acceptance: Statement/2 and supported statement/3 receipts survive send, acknowledgment loss, restart and retry without silently losing a receipt or duplicating an obligation.
requirements.evidence_limit: Reviewed helpers reject statement/3; candidate correction has synthetic evidence only.
requirements.required_evidence: Exact-version engine plus helper integration and restart tests

requirements.title: A private managed workspace
requirements.scope: Authenticated API, business isolation, least-privilege access, single-writer control, local storage ownership, exports and bounded capacity.
requirements.acceptance: One business cannot read or write another’s records; concurrent requests are safely serialized; capacity limits are explicit and observable.
requirements.evidence_limit: The reviewed engine is a local SQLite CLI. A hosted multi-customer service is new work.
requirements.required_evidence: Isolation and authorization tests; failure handling; capacity evidence

requirements.title: Recovery that actually works
requirements.scope: Consistent backups, retention policy, monitored backup age, restore procedure and controlled upgrades with rollback rehearsal.
requirements.acceptance: Restore a representative workspace and reconcile its records and receipts. Publish only recovery-time and recovery-point commitments supported by drills.
requirements.evidence_limit: No verified hosted recovery or uptime guarantee. SQLite is viable with disciplined local-volume and writer ownership.
requirements.required_evidence: Restore drill; reconciliation report; upgrade/rollback drill

requirements.title: Operated event delivery
requirements.scope: Approved source/destination adapters, durable queue, deduplication keys, bounded retries, failure quarantine, alerts and operator replay.
requirements.acceptance: Dropped acknowledgments, duplicate events, out-of-order arrival and downstream outage produce visible, recoverable outcomes with no silent data loss in the qualified profile.
requirements.evidence_limit: We transport customer-provided facts; we do not decide whether their business outcome is true.
requirements.required_evidence: Fault-injection traces; queue state; operator recovery evidence

requirements.title: Predictable infrastructure pricing
requirements.scope: Monthly workspace capacity bands; later connection/workload bands; included reliability and explicit limits. Measure operating and support costs before prices.
requirements.acceptance: A buyer can identify included storage, retention, traffic, support and overage behavior before agreeing. Unit economics remain viable under measured use.
requirements.evidence_limit: No price has been approved. No revenue share, seat fee or correction fee in this proposed offer.
requirements.required_evidence: Cost model; buyer interviews; approved offer and terms

requirements.title: Keep control and leave cleanly
requirements.scope: Portable exports covering policies, events, obligations and receipts; documented version compatibility, migration rehearsal and offboarding process.
requirements.acceptance: A customer can export a sample managed workspace and verify equivalent records in a supported self-hosted environment.
requirements.evidence_limit: Local records exist; hosted export/import parity and migration are unqualified. Postgres is a later need-led option.
requirements.required_evidence: Round-trip reconciliation; documented ownership and retention terms

flow.scope: Reviewed local source-built profile; capabilities vary by version and native qualification
inputs: customer terms, prices, currency and periods
work events, usage quantities and stable IDs
engine: preserve durable history, retry identity and corrections
calculate amounts and reconcile billing periods
outputs: policy references, saved receipts and correction history
JSON statements and supported finance CSV exports
flow.human_value: Explain and reconcile bills using retained evidence and terms
flow.agent_value: Use versioned inputs, stable retry identities and structured receipts/statements without interpreting a dashboard

technical_capabilities.scope: Named source-built local SQLite M4/M5 profiles; not native package parity
protections: append-only history and immutable closed statements
reporting: customer billing periods with timezone/month-end/DST rules
separate versioned fiscal calendar including supported 4-4-5-family patterns
linked post-close adjustments and explicit ad hoc statements
explicit recurrence with no background charges
